title: sla.getsli
description: Calculate the Service Level Indicator (SLI) data for a Service Level Agreement (SLA).

slaid.description: ID of the SLA to return availability information for. Property behavior: required.

period_from.description: Starting timestamp (inclusive) to report the SLI for. Possible values: Unix timestamp.

period_to.description: Ending timestamp (inclusive) to report the SLI for. Possible values: Unix timestamp.

periods.description: Number of periods to report. Possible values: 1-100.

serviceids.description: IDs of services to return the SLI for.
